optional_fields.author: string
optional_fields.roll: boolean — whether a randomize roll may pick this asset. Default: the type's roll.asset (true unless the type says otherwise). Runtime overrides (settings) win over this.

optional_fields.wrapGroups: boolean, default false — every section / group (Container) is collapsible with a toggle in its top-right corner (build option --wrap-groups; compiles to --fx-wrap-groups 1|0)

optional_fields.slots: region → list of asset types that region accepts. Overrides the defaults in `slots.defaults` per region; a chrome region renders only when it accepts its asset type. Keys must be a region in `slots.regions`, values known asset types.

optional_fields.menus[].order: number — placement of a menu created by a contribution (default 100; asset menus keep their order)

optional_fields.window: id or kind of the window this toolbar is attached to (`main` by default); the window-settings icon renders only when the toolbar is inside a floating window
optional_fields.density: compact | regular (default) | roomy — toolbar padding and button height
optional_fields.divider: boolean, default true — rule between item groups
optional_fields.search: object — live search: { live: boolean (dropdown that updates on every keystroke), placeholder?: string, maxResults?: number (default 12), kinds?: string[] (limit to result kinds: view, action, setting, settings-tab, dialog, asset, window, text) }. Without it (or live:false) the search box is the classic submit-to-jump box.
optional_fields.groups[].items[].badge: string — name of a runtime counter (runtime.setBadge) shown as a small badge on the button, e.g. `alerts.unread`; hidden at 0
optional_fields.widgets: [{type, id, at: start|end, order?}] — widget assets (clock, search bar, logo, action button, label, status, counter, progress, avatar, link, theme switch, spacer, divider) placed at the toolbar's start or end. Runtime widgets (rt.attachToToolbar) with the same type+id replace these.
optional_fields.collapsible: boolean, default false — a chevron at the toolbar's end folds it to a thin handle (and back); the fold is remembered per device (setting axf.toolbar.collapsed)

widgets._doc: Widget host: only widget types ("widget": true) are placed; missing assets are skipped.

optional_fields.indicator: auto (default, per style) | bar | fill | none — active-item marker

gauge.label: Gauge
gauge.description: How gauges look (speed, files, data dials): shape, thickness, needle, ticks, ends and readout. Every gauge in every app follows the active gauge asset.

meter.label: Progress meter
meter.description: How progress meters look (install bars, step bars): shape, height, corners, stripes, motion and fill. Every progress meter in every app follows the active meter asset.

banner.label: Banner
banner.description: Thin permanent bar across the top of the screen (above the layout). Shows the app logo and holds attached assets (badges and widgets: clock, search bar, logo, buttons, counters, …) on its left, center or right; plugins attach more at run time.

attach._doc: data.attach = [{type, id, at: left|center|right, order?}]. Every attachable type ("attachable": true: badges and all widgets) is placed; an entry whose asset doesn't exist is skipped. Runtime attachments (rt.attachToBanner) with the same type+id replace the asset's own.

optional_fields.divider: boolean — line under the banner (default true)

clock.label: Clock
clock.description: A clock widget: attaches to banners and toolbars (any widget host).

optional_fields.timezone: string — IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York); default the device's

search-bar.label: Search bar
search-bar.description: A search bar widget: searches the whole app (views, settings, actions, assets, windows, words on the page, and anything a module adds, e.g. the console's plan features, pending builds and plugins). Attaches to banners and toolbars.

optional_fields.kinds: string[] — only these result kinds (default: all)
optional_fields.shortcut: boolean — Ctrl/Cmd+K and / focus it (default true)

action-button.label: Action button
action-button.description: An action button widget: one action with an icon and/or label (e.g. Settings, Build, Open terminal). Its look follows the active button style (the `button` control asset).

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: A logo widget: the app's wordmark, an image or an icon, for banners and toolbars. The banner's own logo (data.logo) stays; this one goes anywhere a widget goes.

optional_fields.image: string — image URL or app path (https:, data:, or a path the app serves) when kind is image
optional_fields.icon: string — icon name when kind is icon (falls back to the text when the icon is unknown)
optional_fields.link: string — action spec run on tap (e.g. app.settings, view.open:home)

label.label: Label
label.description: A label widget: a short static text (caption, version, environment name) in a tone.

status.label: Status
status.description: A status widget: a dot + text bound to a runtime counter (runtime.setBadge): on while the counter is above zero (e.g. ai.connected, build.running), off otherwise.

optional_fields.link: string — action spec run on tap

counter.label: Counter
counter.description: A counter widget: a number bound to a runtime counter (runtime.setBadge), e.g. unread alerts or waiting approvals; 99+ past max.

optional_fields.label: string — text after the number
optional_fields.link: string — action spec run on tap

progress.label: Progress
progress.description: A progress widget: a bar bound to a runtime counter (0 to max), e.g. a build or a download.

optional_fields.label: string — text before the bar
optional_fields.showValue: boolean — percent after the bar (default false)

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.description: An avatar widget: the signed-in account's initials (runtime.bindPrincipal) or a fixed text/image.

optional_fields.text: string — initials or a name (initials are derived) when source is text, and the fallback when no account is bound
optional_fields.image: string — image URL or app path when source is image
optional_fields.link: string — action spec run on tap (e.g. settings.open:account)

link.label: Link
link.description: A link widget: opens a web address (https, http, mailto, tel) in the browser; anything else is refused and the widget is not drawn.

optional_fields.external: boolean — open in a new tab / outside the app (default true)

theme-switch.label: Theme switch
theme-switch.description: A theme switch widget: toggles the active color theme between a light and a dark one (runtime.swap).

spacer.label: Spacer
spacer.description: A spacer widget: a gap between widgets; flex pushes what follows to the other end.

divider.label: Divider
divider.description: A divider widget: a thin vertical rule between widgets.

optional_fields.inset: boolean — shorter than the host (default true)

badge.label: Badge
badge.description: A small status badge (icon, label, tone) that attaches to the banner. Plugins supply their own badges.

optional_fields.link: string — action spec run on tap (e.g. settings.open:x)

settings.label: Settings interface
settings.description: The settings page as an asset, so several apps share one settings interface with the same options: layout (tabs on top, at the side, or a list), header, search, descriptions, which tabs show in which order and with which labels, what is left out (tab, group, panel or setting ids), and extra groups of data-only options (toggle, text, number, slider, choice, multi_choice, color, link, section) the app gets while the asset is active. Engine core/engines/settingsui.ts.

rollDefaults._doc: Randomize rolls. slot = the slot takes part in a roll (randomize all); asset = default for an asset's own `roll` flag. Types may override with their own `roll` block. uac-policy is never rolled.

hideDefaults._doc: Hidden slots. A type with "hideable": true gets a Hidden choice in Settings → Appearance → Assets; while hidden its chrome is not drawn (the layout drops its region; a hidden context menu leaves the platform's own menu) and rolls skip it. Only chrome types: hiding a theme, layout, control or policy would leave nothing to draw with. Runtime overrides: settings axf.hide.<type> (Kotlin: KV <key>:hide).

attachDefaults._doc: Attachable types ("attachable": true) aren't slots you pick in Appearance → Assets: their assets are attached to a host by the host's data or by modules at run time, and they're never rolled. Widgets ("widget": true) attach to every host (banners, toolbars); badges to hosts with an `attach` block (banners). A host's `attach` block without `types` takes every attachable type; a `widgets` block takes every widget type.

menuItems._doc: Menu items (app-menu menus[].items, context-menu targets.*, nested `items`) take these optional fields on top of id/label/icon/action/shortcut/requires/items/separator. `provider` names a live-list provider registered at run time (runtime.registerAppMenuProvider): the item becomes a submenu whose entries are asked for on open, capped at providerMax with a More… entry. `badge` names a runtime counter shown as a badge (hidden at 0), like toolbar items. `checked` binds a check mark: setting:<key> (truthy value), counter:<name> (> 0), slot:<type> (chrome slot shown), hidden:<type> (chrome slot hidden). `order` / `before` / `after` place a contributed item among its siblings (engines/appmenu.ts; fixture spec/fixtures/app-menu.json; Android twin deferred, port on hold Oct 21 2026).

optional_fields.provider: string — id of a registered live-list provider
optional_fields.before: string — sibling id to go before
optional_fields.after: string — sibling id to go after
